name: PDF Crop Refresh
changes: New Send feedback command. It opens a page where you can report a problem or suggest an idea.
tip: After you replace a source PDF, run "Refresh crops in active note" to redraw the PNG images of that note.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. PDF Crop Refresh is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it in your research notes.
